scripts.build: npm run build -w @visahobe/shared && npm run build -w @visahobe/server && npm run build -w @visahobe/web && npm run build -w @visahobe/browser-worker
scripts.test: npm run test -w @visahobe/server && npm run test -w @visahobe/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/browser-worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -b apps/web
